evidence.ACL: chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance
evidence.MCL: The medial collateral ligamentous complexes are intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: radial tears at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: large radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus
evidence.Medial OA: Mild medial tibiofemoral compartmental osteoarthritis of the right knee by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral bone cyst and osteophytes.
evidence.Lateral OA: There is chronic osteochondral injury at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 2.3* 1.3 cm).
evidence.PF OA: The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion.
evidence.Effusion: Some amount of right knee effusion is present.
evidence.Fracture: chronic osteochondral injury at the posterolateral tibial plateau
